title: Product Discovery Record
description: Data model for a discovered product candidate in HYDRA. Product Discovery decides which product deserves an advertisement before any creative is generated. Data model only — no scraping, recommendation logic, or AI.

product_id.description: Stable HYDRA identifier for the discovered product.

marketplace.description: Marketplace the product was discovered on, e.g. Coupang.

product_url.description: Link to the product listing; the input to the marketplace adapter.

estimated_margin.description: Estimated profit margin as a percentage (0-100). Null until estimated.

market_fit_score.description: Market Fit Engine score (0-100). Null until the product has been evaluated.

discovery_source.description: Where/how the product was discovered, e.g. a marketplace ranking or feed.

discovery_date.description: When the product was discovered (ISO 8601 date-time).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the discovered product.
